title: BA1/448/2012 of DHIRAJ BATTA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Original Jurisdiction
Dated: Nainital: the 19th day of April, 2012
1st Bail Application No.448 of 2012
Order on the Bail Application:
CRIMINAL SIDE
Dhiraj Batta S/o Late Praveen Batta,
R/o Khalsa School Road, Gali No. 4, P.S./-Khanna,
District-Ludhiyana, Punjab.
 ÖÖÖApplicant (in Jail)
Versus
State of Uttarakhand
 ÖÖ Opposite Party

Arising out of Crime No. 91 of 2012, under Section
8/15/18 of NDPS Act, Police Station-Kotwali Gangnahar,
Roorkee, District-Haridwar.

Honíble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. S.K. Shandilya, Advocate, present for the
applicant.
Mr. B.S. Parihar, Brief holder, present for the State.
Heard.
Applicant-Dhiraj Batta, who is in jail in connection
with crime No. 91 of 2012, relating to offence punishable
under Section 8/15/18 Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic
Substance Act, 1985, Police Station-Kotwali Gangnahar,
Roorkee, District-Haridwar, has sought his release on bail.

2
The quantity of Opium i.e. 1.136 kilogram, said to
have been recovered from the applicant, is less then
commercial quantity. Also 1.775 kilogram Poppy Straw
(DODA) said to have been recovered from the applicant is
not only less then commercial quantity but also almost
equal to small quantity. There are no public witnesses. It
is pleaded on behalf of the applicant that applicant has no
criminal history. Co-accused Amit Sharma has already
been directed to released on bail.
In the above circumstances, without expressing any
opinion as to final merits of the case, this Court is of the
view that the applicant deserves bail.
The bail application is allowed. Let the applicant-Dhiraj Batta be released on bail on executing personal
bond by him and furnishing two sureties each of the like
amount of satisfaction of Court concerned.
